info.title: Paysafe Payments API
info.description:
The Payments API is the single REST integration point for accepting card payments, bank transfers, wallets and local payment methods. It supersedes the legacy Cards API for new integrations.

---

**DEMO SPECIFICATION — NOT A REAL PAYSAFE API.** This document was generated for a GitBook proof of concept. The endpoints, schemas and examples are fabricated and describe no live Paysafe system. For the real Paysafe API, see https://developer.paysafe.com.
